name: dev2
seeds: I'm Aditya Kulkarni, born 14 August 1986. I've lived in Pune since 2015; before that I was in Bengaluru.
My wife Meera and I got married on 9 Dec 2012. Our daughter Ira was born on 3 March 2017 and our son Kabir on 21-06-2021.

My father Vasant passed away on 2 Feb 2019. Baba married Lata when I was six, so she's my stepmother — Lata-aai to us. Her son Rohan is my half-brother; he's a doctor at Godavari Hospital in Nashik. Rohan and my sister-in-law Shruti got married in May 2020.
माझी बहीण Anuja Thane ला राहते. तिचे पती Sachin, माझे मेहुणे, TCS मध्ये project manager आहेत.
Meera's mother Sunanda moved to Pune to stay with us in January 2024. Prakash Deshpande has been my closest friend since COEP days. I did engineering at COEP from 2004 to 2008.
Dr. Anand Joshi has been our family doctor for years. Also, when is Ira's birthday again?
I worked at Infosys in Bengaluru from 2009 to 2015, then joined Persistent Systems in July 2016 as a tech lead.

seeds.text:
Subject: Promotion letter

Dear Aditya,

We are pleased to inform you that you have been promoted to Senior Engineering Manager with effect from 1 April 2023. Your revised CTC will be ₹38,50,000 per annum. You will continue to report to Neha Bhatia, VP – Engineering.

Regards,
HR Team, Persistent Systems

seeds: Farhan Shaikh from my team and I handle the Bajaj Finserv account — Bajaj has been a Persistent client since 2019. Our contact there is Kavita Rao, their CTO.

Big news: Prakash and I founded Sahyadri Trails LLP on 1 Nov 2024 — weekend treks out of Pune. We're 50:50 partners and each put in ₹5 lakh as starting capital. I'm keeping my Persistent job for now. The launch is planned for February 2025; Prakash is mapping the trek routes.
Member of the Pune Hikers Club since 2018, and a life member of the COEP Alumni Association. I want to do the Everest Base Camp trek in 2027. Oh, and correction: I joined Infosys in 2010, not 2009.

For the Sahyadri Trails launch we hired Vivek Pandit to do the website and logo — paid him ₹60,000 on 20 Jan 2025. Sunil Gokhale is our CA at ₹8,000 a month. The first trek, to Rajgad, went out on 15 Feb 2025 with 22 people — launch done!

seeds.text:
AGREEMENT FOR SALE (summary)
Property: Flat No. B-402, Shubham Residency, Kothrud, Pune 411038
Purchasers: Aditya V. Kulkarni & Meera A. Kulkarni (joint)
Vendor: Rajesh Pawar
Consideration: Rs. 72,00,000/- (Rupees Seventy-Two Lakh only)
Date of registration: 18/05/2015

seeds: When we first came to Pune we rented a 1BHK in Karve Nagar, March to July 2015 — ₹12,000 a month to Mrs. Shobha Apte — until the Kothrud flat registration came through.

Baba left Rohan and me his farmland at Sinnar, near Nashik, jointly — 7/12 survey no. 112/2. The mutation in both our names came through in August 2019. Shrikant mama, my uncle who lives in Sinnar, looks after the land for us.
Bought a plot in Bavdhan from Suresh Jagtap on 5 Jan 2022 for ₹48 lakh, survey no. 34/1A. Had to borrow ₹2,50,000 from Sachin that month for the stamp duty.
मैंने अपनी पुरानी Activa Farhan को 10/09/2025 को ₹28,000 में बेच दी। वो कई महीनों से पूछ रहा था।

Our car is a white Creta, MH 12 RT 4471, bought from Kothari Hyundai in Oct 2020 for ₹14.2 lakh on-road. The Creta insurance is with ICICI Lombard, policy 3001/58843210/00/000 — renews on 28 Oct 2026. Paid ₹18,450 premium in Oct 2025.
My passport (Z4419027) expires on 22/02/2027. I'll apply for renewal in November — need it for the Japan trip we're planning for April 2027, budget about ₹6 lakh for the four of us.
We're planning to build our own house on the Bavdhan plot — budget ₹65 lakh all-in. Architect is Nikhil Bhave; his fee is fixed at ₹3,50,000. Meera is handling all the interior decisions.

seeds.text:
Subject: Bavdhan house – civil quotes

Hi Aditya,

We have three quotes for the civil work:
- Shinde Constructions: ₹62,00,000
- Patil Builders: ₹58,50,000
- Om Sai Developers: ₹66,00,000

Please sign the plan drawings by 10 Feb 2024 so I can file them with PMRDA.

Regards,
Nikhil Bhave

seeds: Final: we're going with Patil Builders. Sanjay Patil, who runs it, agreed to ₹56 lakh for the civil work after some haggling. Bhoomi pujan done on 14 April 2024 and work has started.

Paid Sanjay ₹14,00,000 as the first instalment on 20/04/2024. Plinth was done by end of July; paid him the second ₹12 lakh on 2 Aug 2024. Also paid Sachin back the full ₹2.5 lakh on 15 Feb 2024 — that loan's cleared.
Slab cast on 12 Nov 2024! Paid Sanjay ₹15 lakh for the slab stage the same week.
Correction on the slab payment — it was ₹13.5 lakh, not 15. Electrician is Ganesh More; he quoted ₹2,40,000 for the full wiring.

seeds.text: 15 June 2025. Monsoon's here and Sanjay has stopped work at Bavdhan until the rains ease, so the house is paused for now. Meera and I decided to drop the terrace garden to stay within budget.

seeds: Work restarted at Bavdhan on 1 Sept 2025. Paid Ganesh ₹80,000 advance for the wiring on 8 Sep 2025. How much have we paid Patil Builders so far?
Bavdhan house is complete! Sanjay handed over the keys on 16 Aug 2026 and I paid him the final ₹16.5 lakh that day. Griha pravesh is on 6 September 2026.

Moved out of Kothrud into the Bavdhan house on 8 Sep 2026. Sold the Kothrud flat to Hitesh Mehta for ₹1.35 crore — registration done on 7 Oct 2026. Our new neighbour in Bavdhan is Col. Arvind Thakur, very helpful.
Rohan sent me ₹1,20,000 on 2 Oct 2026 — my half of this year's lease money from the Sinnar land.
Kerala trip with the family, 22–28 Dec 2025. Sad news soon after: Meera's grandfather Dattatray Joshi passed away on 11 Jan 2026.
Kabir's dentist appointment with Dr. Kale is on 24 Oct 2026, 5 pm. Ira's class teacher this year is Mrs. Gadgil.
Dr. Kale's clinic moved Kabir's dentist appointment to 31 Oct. Also, Sahyadri Trails' ITR is due on 31 Oct 2026 — Sunil and I decided to switch the firm to quarterly GST filing.

seeds.text: 1 Jan 2026 — resolutions. I plan to leave Persistent by March 2028 and run Sahyadri Trails full-time. Meera wants to restart her architecture practice once Kabir is in school. Someday I'd love to build a small farm-stay on the Sinnar land. We'll take Lata-aai to Kashi sometime in 2027.

seeds: Meera and I decided to put ₹50 lakh from the flat sale into an FD for Ira and Kabir's education. Also planning Ira's 10th birthday party for March 2027, budget around ₹40k.
